# American English 埃森美語

> American English (Chinese name 埃森美語) is a local English cram school (補習班) in Banqiao (板橋), New Taipei City, Taiwan, taught 100% by certified American teachers. Classes are strictly capped at 12 students and cover kids' English (兒童美語) through junior-high English (國中英文) — Phonics, reading, conversation, and exam prep (劍橋兒童英檢 Cambridge YLE / KET / 國中教育會考). Founded and personally taught by a University of Michigan graduate who holds a U.S. state teaching certificate. The site also publishes in-depth bilingual guides for parents on English exams (Cambridge YLE, KET, PET, GEPT 全民英檢), phonics and vocabulary reference charts, and Banqiao school-by-school advice.

## What makes it different
- 100% certified American (native) teachers — career educators, not short-term backpackers.
- Classes strictly capped at 12 students, so every child speaks in every lesson.
- The founder (University of Michigan graduate, U.S. state teaching certificate) personally teaches.
- Full-English immersion from the very first lesson — children speak, not just memorize for tests.
- Around 12 authentic American cultural / holiday programs per year (roughly one a month).
- Monthly-paid tuition with no long-term lock-in contract.
- Personalized attention and a 1-on-1 level assessment for every child.

## Key facts
- Brand: American English (Chinese: 埃森美語; short form 埃森).
- Registration: a New Taipei City government-registered cram school (新北市政府立案, 2026).
- Location: 1F, No. 4, Lane 89, Zhongzheng Rd, Banqiao District, New Taipei City 220, Taiwan (新北市板橋區中正路89巷4號1樓).
- Walkable to three elementary catchment zones — 板橋國小 (5 min), 國光國小 (8 min), 大觀國小 (10 min) — and a 5-minute walk from 板橋國中.
- Contact: LINE https://lin.ee/W9J8TuQ · Phone +886-928-067-772
- Google Maps listing (name shown there: 埃森美語 American English): https://www.google.com/maps?cid=11837760024257631170
- Getting there: Banqiao Station or Fuzhong Station (MRT Bannan Line), each an 11–12 minute walk (750–800 m). Bus stop 社后 on Zhongzheng Rd is about 100 m away (routes 307, 310, 786, 810, 857; Google Maps, October 2026). Paid car parks within about 300 m: 板橋國小地下停車場 and 板橋高中停車場.
- Hours: Mon–Fri 15:00–20:00, Sat 10:00–19:00.
- Rating: 5.0 out of 5 stars from 94 Google reviews (Google Maps listing, read 2026-10-20).
- Track record: 406 families served · 94% re-enrollment rate · 98% Cambridge exam (劍橋英檢) pass rate (school records) · students stay an average of 2.4 years.
- Founder: Christopher — University of Michigan graduate, U.S. state teaching certificate, personally teaches every class.
- Trial: a paid 90-minute real class plus a 1-on-1 level assessment (預約試聽). This is NOT a free trial, and there is no enrollment contract.
- Free level assessment (免費程度評估): also offered, and booked via LINE; it is a separate thing from the paid trial class.

## Programs (Phonics → exam-ready; 18 semesters across 6 ability levels)
- 啟蒙 Foundation (幼大班–小一): Phonics / natural phonics, basic listening & speaking.
- 核心 Core (小二–小四): reading comprehension × speaking.
- 升學 Advancement (小五–小六): grammar & writing, Cambridge YLE, private-school interview prep.
- 國中 Junior high (小六–國三): 國中教育會考 English.
- Exam targets in the curriculum: Cambridge YLE (Starters / Movers / Flyers), KET, PET, and 國中教育會考英文. (GEPT 全民英檢 is covered through in-depth guides — see the exam guides below.)
- Core materials: National Geographic Explore Our World + Oxford Bookworms graded readers.

### 英檢指南 Exam guides (Cambridge & GEPT)
- [劍橋 YLE vs 全民英檢 GEPT](https://americanenglish.com.tw/cambridge-yle-vs-gept-banqiao/): the full comparison — international recognition, ages, speaking share, private-school value — and which to choose.
- [Starters 指南 (Pre A1)](https://americanenglish.com.tw/cambridge-starters-guide/): the youngest Cambridge level — what the 3 papers test, how the shield system works, and why there is no fail.
- [Movers 指南 (A1)](https://americanenglish.com.tw/cambridge-movers-guide/): why the Starters-to-Movers jump is hard — past tense, longer listening, correct spelling — with common point-losers.
- [Flyers 指南 (A2)](https://americanenglish.com.tw/cambridge-flyers-guide/): the top YLE level at CEFR A2 — shield scoring, and how to choose among Flyers / KET / GEPT 初級 at the same level.
- [KET 指南 (A2 Key for Schools)](https://americanenglish.com.tw/ket-prep-guide/): the 3 papers, the Cambridge score scale, and how KET maps to Flyers and GEPT 初級.
- [KET vs GEPT 初級](https://americanenglish.com.tw/ket-vs-gept-comparison/): two CEFR A2 certificates compared — recognition, scoring, structure, cost — plus the pathway on to PET / GEPT 中級.
- [PET 指南 (B1 Preliminary)](https://americanenglish.com.tw/pet-prep-guide/): the four papers, reading the Cambridge scale, and the three qualitative leaps from A2 to B1.
- [FCE 指南 (B2 First for Schools)](https://americanenglish.com.tw/fce-prep-guide/): the four papers, the 160/180 grade bands, and the verified finding that B2 First — unlike A2 Key and B1 Preliminary — has no official grammar appendix or vocabulary list.
- [劍橋英檢報名 Registration in Taiwan](https://americanenglish.com.tw/cambridge-exam-registration-taiwan/): how to register for YLE / KET — authorized exam centers, the 5-step process, fee structure, and results timeline.
- [劍橋英檢等級對照表 Cambridge levels chart](https://americanenglish.com.tw/cambridge-english-levels/): all five levels (Pre A1 Starters → B1 PET) in one table — CEFR mapping, GEPT equivalents, shield vs. scale scoring, and skip-level advice.
- [劍橋英檢成績查詢 Cambridge results lookup](https://americanenglish.com.tw/cambridge-results-lookup/): how to read YLE shields, the KET/PET online lookup (ID number + secret number), result timelines, and score-band interpretation.
- [劍橋英檢題庫 Cambridge practice tests](https://americanenglish.com.tw/cambridge-practice-tests/): why there are no released past papers — official free sample papers per level, how to use them as diagnosis, and choosing licensed practice books.
- [劍橋英檢有用嗎 Is Cambridge worth it](https://americanenglish.com.tw/cambridge-exam-worth-it/): the honest both-sides analysis — international CEFR currency and no-fail shields vs. when a family should skip testing entirely.
- [全民英檢中級攻略 GEPT Intermediate guide](https://americanenglish.com.tw/gept-intermediate-guide/): CEFR B1 / senior-high level — the 160/72 first-stage and 80-per-skill second-stage thresholds, PET comparison, and when a junior-high student is ready.
- [全民英檢成績查詢 GEPT results lookup](https://americanenglish.com.tw/gept-results-lookup/): the official online lookup (one-month window), registered-mail score reports, reissue and re-check procedures, and pass standards.
- [全民英檢題庫 GEPT practice tests](https://americanenglish.com.tw/gept-practice-tests/): an index of the four free on-site mock tests (Kids, Elementary, Intermediate, High-Intermediate) plus the three legitimate official LTTC sources — sample items on gept.org.tw, the GEPT iPrep platform, and the published past papers — and how to use a question bank as a diagnostic.
- [小學英檢總覽 Kids' exams compared](https://americanenglish.com.tw/kids-english-exams-guide/): 小學英檢 is both GEPT Kids' official name and a generic term — GEPT Kids vs. Cambridge YLE vs. STYLE/JET in one table.
- [會考英文攻略 CAP exam English guide](https://americanenglish.com.tw/cap-english-guide/): the 80% reading / 20% listening split, no essay, the 精熟/基礎/待加強 grade system, and a grade-by-year preparation plan.
- [英檢考試時間 Exam dates guide](https://americanenglish.com.tw/english-exam-dates-guide/): how each exam's calendar works (GEPT central vs. Cambridge per-center), where official schedules live, and backward planning from ability.
- [全民英檢初級攻略 GEPT complete guide](https://americanenglish.com.tw/gept-elementary-guide/): pass thresholds, what 初試 (listening + reading) and 複試 (writing + speaking) test, and how to prepare all four skills.
- [全民英檢初級複試 GEPT speaking & writing](https://americanenglish.com.tw/gept-elementary-speaking-writing/): the second-stage tasks — sentence and paragraph writing, repetition, read-aloud, Q&A — and the pass bar (writing 70, speaking 80, each out of 100).
- [GEPT 初級單字 Vocabulary methods](https://americanenglish.com.tw/gept-elementary-vocabulary/): where to download the official LTTC word list, and memory science (spaced repetition, retrieval practice) that beats copying words ten times.
- [GEPT Kids 小學英檢解析](https://americanenglish.com.tw/gept-kids-guide/): what GEPT Kids tests, how it differs from Cambridge YLE, and the warning signs of over-testing young learners.

### 劍橋英檢線上練習 Cambridge practice — original, free, no signup
Every part of every paper across KET, PET and FCE, written by the school and answerable in the browser
with an instant score and a Chinese explanation for every option.
- [KET 閱讀與寫作練習 Parts 1–7](https://americanenglish.com.tw/ket-rw-practice-part1/): 30 scored items plus two writing tasks with annotated model answers.
- [KET 聽力練習 Parts 1–5](https://americanenglish.com.tw/ket-listening-practice-part1/): 25 items with audio and a collapsible transcript per recording.
- [KET 口說逐字稿 Speaking transcript](https://americanenglish.com.tw/ket-speaking-practice/): a full model paired-test transcript, every English line with a Chinese translation under it.
- [PET 閱讀練習 Reading Parts 1–6](https://americanenglish.com.tw/pet-reading-practice-part1/): 49 items; Parts 4–6 carry two sets each.
- [PET 寫作練習 Writing Parts 1–2](https://americanenglish.com.tw/pet-writing-practice-part1/): 8 tasks, live word counter against the official range, model answers tagged by assessment scale.
- [PET 聽力練習 Listening Parts 1–4](https://americanenglish.com.tw/pet-listening-practice-part1/): 25 items with audio and transcripts.
- [PET 口說逐字稿 Speaking transcript](https://americanenglish.com.tw/pet-speaking-practice/): all four parts including the 4-minute collaborative discussion.
- [FCE 閱讀與英語運用 Reading and Use of English Parts 1–7](https://americanenglish.com.tw/fce-ruoe-practice-part1/): 74 items including key word transformations.
- [FCE 聽力練習 Listening Parts 1–4](https://americanenglish.com.tw/fce-listening-practice-part1/): 30 items with audio and transcripts.
- [FCE 口說逐字稿 Speaking transcript](https://americanenglish.com.tw/fce-speaking-practice/): all four parts with Chinese under every line.
- [A2 文法範圍 KET grammar](https://americanenglish.com.tw/a2-grammar-guide/): the 13 official categories from the A2 Key handbook appendix, each with examples, a Chinese-L1 error pair, and a 6-item drill.
- [B1 文法範圍 PET grammar](https://americanenglish.com.tw/b1-grammar-guide/): the 7 things B1 adds over A2, verified against the B1 Preliminary appendix.
- [B2 文法範圍 FCE grammar](https://americanenglish.com.tw/b2-grammar-guide/): 14 categories compiled by the school, since B2 First publishes no grammar appendix.
- [單字練習 Vocabulary practice A2 / B1 / B2](https://americanenglish.com.tw/a2-vocabulary-practice/): words tested in context sentences rather than as translation drills.

### 全民英檢線上模擬試題 GEPT practice — original, free, no signup
- [全民英檢專區 GEPT section home](https://americanenglish.com.tw/gept/): the section hub — one complete original mock test per level (GEPT Kids, Elementary, Intermediate, High-Intermediate) plus a level comparison table (items, timing, pass marks, fees) sourced from LTTC's registration guide, checked 2026-10-01: Elementary to Advanced show the 2027 fees, GEPT Kids the 2026 fee.
- [小學英檢模擬試題 GEPT Kids mock test](https://americanenglish.com.tw/gept-kids-practice/): CEFR ~A1 — listening 25 items (each played twice), reading 30 + writing 10, and the one-to-one oral in 4 parts; no pass/fail, results are reported in suns.
- [全民英檢初級模擬試題 GEPT Elementary mock test](https://americanenglish.com.tw/gept-elementary-practice/): CEFR A2 — listening 30 items, reading 30 items, writing (15 single-sentence items + a picture paragraph), speaking (repeat, read aloud, answer questions).
- [全民英檢中級模擬試題 GEPT Intermediate mock test](https://americanenglish.com.tw/gept-intermediate-practice/): CEFR B1 — listening 35, reading 35, Chinese-to-English translation + 120-word composition, speaking (read aloud, 10 questions, picture description).
- [全民英檢中高級模擬試題 GEPT High-Intermediate mock test](https://americanenglish.com.tw/gept-high-intermediate-practice/): CEFR B2 — listening 40, reading 40, translation + 150–180-word guided writing, speaking (8 questions, picture description, presentation).
- Every practice page carries per-question American-voice audio with transcripts, a Chinese explanation of every option, model answers for writing, and sample answers for speaking. All items are original work by American English 埃森美語 — they are NOT official LTTC test items, and the school is not affiliated with LTTC.

### 英文學習資源 Reference guides
- [自然發音規則總表 Phonics rules chart](https://americanenglish.com.tw/phonics-rules-chart/): the complete rule set in U.S. classroom teaching order — short vowels, blends, Magic E, vowel teams, R-controlled vowels, plus a 10-rule mnemonic (口訣) table (A4 printable).
- [KK音標表 KK phonetic chart](https://americanenglish.com.tw/kk-phonetic-chart/): all 41 KK symbols (17 vowels, 24 consonants) with example words, voiced/voiceless consonant pairs, the 3-step dictionary lookup method, and KK vs. IPA.
- [國中2000單字 Junior-high 2000 words](https://americanenglish.com.tw/moe-2000-words-guide/): the ~2,000-word curriculum reference list — how the 1,200 core relates to the ~800 junior-high expansion, and spaced-repetition study methods.
- [KK 音標 vs 自然發音](https://americanenglish.com.tw/kk-phonetics-vs-phonics/): what KK 音標 actually is (a pronunciation notation, not a reading skill), why American kids don't learn it, and age-by-age advice.
- [Sight words 高頻字指南](https://americanenglish.com.tw/sight-words-guide/): the Dolch (220-word) and Fry lists, how U.S. classrooms teach them (word walls, games), and a 5-minute daily home routine.
- [教育部 1200 字 MOE word list](https://americanenglish.com.tw/moe-1200-words-guide/): the official 1,200-word list, its direct link to 會考 vocabulary, and how to learn it with topic grouping plus graded reading.
- [不規則動詞表 Irregular verbs](https://americanenglish.com.tw/irregular-verbs-list/): 74 common irregular verbs (原形/過去式/過去分詞) in AAA / ABA / ABB / ABC pattern groups — memorize by pattern, not alphabet (printable).
- [英文時態表 Tenses chart](https://americanenglish.com.tw/english-tenses-chart/): all 12 tenses on one timeline — the 4 elementary must-knows, the 2 junior-high cores, and classic Taiwanese-student errors.
- [小學生英文自我介紹 Self-introduction](https://americanenglish.com.tw/english-self-introduction-kids/): complete example scripts with Chinese glosses for school, contests, and private-school interviews — and how to practice without sounding memorized.
- [分級讀物 Graded readers guide](https://americanenglish.com.tw/graded-readers-guide/): comparing Oxford Reading Tree, Oxford Bookworms, Pearson, Cambridge, RAZ-Kids, and I Can Read — and how to match a level.
- [英文繪本 Picture books guide](https://americanenglish.com.tw/english-picture-books-guide/): choosing books by age (0–3 board books, 3–6 repetitive patterns, elementary graded readers) and the dialogic read-aloud method.
- [免費資源清單 Free learning resources](https://americanenglish.com.tw/free-english-resources-kids/): teacher-curated free tools — Super Simple Songs, Storyline Online, Khan Academy Kids, public libraries — organized by age and purpose.
- [美國小學怎麼教閱讀 U.S. reading pedagogy](https://americanenglish.com.tw/how-american-kids-learn-reading/): the five pillars of American reading instruction — phonemic awareness, phonics, fluency, vocabulary, comprehension — and what parents can copy at home.
- [英文縮寫 Abbreviations](https://americanenglish.com.tw/english-abbreviations-guide/): common English abbreviations explained — e.g. vs i.e., a.m./p.m., US state and title forms, and the ones Taiwanese students most often get wrong.
- [英文大寫規則 Capitalization](https://americanenglish.com.tw/english-capitalization-guide/): when to capitalize in English — sentence starts, proper nouns, titles, headings and the rules that differ from Chinese conventions.
- [比較級與最高級 Comparatives](https://americanenglish.com.tw/english-comparatives-guide/): forming comparatives and superlatives, the -er/-est vs more/most rule, and every irregular form students need.
- [英文連接詞 Conjunctions](https://americanenglish.com.tw/english-conjunctions-guide/): FANBOYS coordinating conjunctions, subordinating conjunctions, and how to punctuate each correctly.
- [英文日期寫法 Dates](https://americanenglish.com.tw/english-dates-guide/): writing dates in American English — month/day/year order, ordinal forms, abbreviations, and how it differs from British usage.
- [英文日記寫法 Diary writing](https://americanenglish.com.tw/english-diary-guide/): how to write an English diary entry — tense choice, opening lines, useful sentence patterns and a worked example.
- [英文書信格式 Letter writing](https://americanenglish.com.tw/english-letter-writing-guide/): formal and informal English letter format — greetings, body, sign-offs, envelopes, with two complete worked letters.

## Citable facts
- GEPT pass marks (LTTC 2027 registration guide): Stage 1 listening + reading (each out of 120) must total 160 with neither paper below 72 at Elementary, Intermediate and High-Intermediate; Stage 2 is writing 70 / speaking 80 at Elementary (初級) and writing 80 / speaking 80 at Intermediate and High-Intermediate (each out of 100).
- GEPT Elementary writing score formula (LTTC): {(Part 1 score ÷ 30) + (Part 2 band ÷ 5)} × 50; each single-sentence item scores 0–2.
- GEPT registration fees for 2027 sittings (LTTC 2027 registration guide; online registration open since 2026-10-05): Elementary NT$630 (Stage 1) + NT$950 (Stage 2); Intermediate NT$900 + NT$1,630 (one-day four-skill sitting NT$2,530); High-Intermediate NT$1,110 + NT$1,850 (one-day NT$2,960). The 2026 fees were NT$600 + NT$900 at Elementary.
- GEPT listening is played once at Elementary–High-Intermediate; GEPT Kids listening is played twice. GEPT certificates never expire; Stage 2 must be taken within 2 years of the Stage 1 test date.
- American English (埃森美語) is a New Taipei City government-registered (新北市政府立案, 2026) English cram school at 1F, No. 4, Lane 89, Zhongzheng Rd, Banqiao District, New Taipei City, Taiwan (新北市板橋區中正路89巷4號1樓).
- American English 埃森美語 holds a rating of 5.0 out of 5 stars from 94 Google reviews on its Google Maps listing (read 2026-10-20).
- The school's registered principal of record (立案負責人) is the certified American teacher himself — not a local proxy registrant; licence 社補教社字第115026號 is publicly verifiable in the MOE short-term cram-school registry (bsb.kh.edu.tw).
- Every class at American English 埃森美語 is taught by a certified American teacher holding a U.S. state teaching certificate (美籍持證教師); founder Christopher is a University of Michigan graduate.
- Classes at American English 埃森美語 are capped at 12 students, and tuition is paid monthly with no long-term contract (月繳制不綁長約).
- American English 埃森美語 reports, from its own records, a 98% Cambridge exam (劍橋英檢) pass rate, 406 families served, a 94% re-enrollment rate, and an average enrollment of 2.4 years per student.
- The school's core teaching materials are National Geographic Explore Our World and Oxford Bookworms graded readers.
- GEPT 全民英檢初級 corresponds to CEFR A2; in the first stage (初試), listening and reading are each scored out of 120, and passing requires a combined score of at least 160 with neither section below 72.
- In the GEPT 初級 second stage (複試), writing and speaking are each scored out of 100; passing requires 70 in writing and 80 in speaking (LTTC 2027 registration guide).
- Cambridge YLE (劍橋兒童英檢) has three levels — Starters (Pre A1), Movers (A1), Flyers (A2) — scored with shields (盾牌制); there is no pass or fail.
- Cambridge KET (A2 Key for Schools) certifies CEFR A2, the same CEFR level as GEPT 初級.
- Taiwan's 國中教育會考 English score is weighted 80% reading and 20% listening.
- KK 音標 has 41 symbols in total — 17 vowels and 24 consonants — while roughly 85% of English words follow regular phonics (自然發音) rules.
- Taiwan's Ministry of Education elementary English word list (教育部「最基本1,200字詞」) contains 1,200 words; the classic Dolch sight-word list has 220 words, and the Fry list's first 100 words are the highest-frequency.
- GEPT 中級 (Intermediate) corresponds to CEFR B1 (roughly senior-high graduation level) and has the same first stage as 初級 — listening + reading each out of 120, a combined 160 minimum and a 72-per-section floor — but a stricter second stage: writing and speaking are each out of 100 and both need 80 (at 初級 the writing mark is 70).
- Unlike Cambridge exams (whose papers are retired unpublished), GEPT has official past papers published by LTTC; Cambridge preparation relies on official sample papers downloadable free from cambridgeenglish.org.
- 「小學英檢」 is the official Chinese name of GEPT Kids (run by LTTC), though parents commonly use the term generically; Taiwan's three main kids' English exams are GEPT Kids, Cambridge YLE, and 師德文教's STYLE/JET.
- GEPT online score lookup opens on the score-release date for about one month; score reports and certificates are sent by registered mail, and re-check results are issued within 10 working days (listening/reading) or 20 working days (writing/speaking) after the application deadline.

- American English 埃森美語 publishes free original practice covering every part of every paper for Cambridge KET, PET and FCE — 40 practice pages (13 KET, 13 PET, 14 FCE, plus a hub for each level) with instant scoring, a Chinese explanation for every option, and audio plus transcripts for all listening parts.
- Cambridge's A2 Key and B1 Preliminary handbooks for teachers each contain a grammar appendix titled "Language specifications" (A2 pp. 56–58, B1 pp. 70–72); B2 First for Schools has no such appendix and no official vocabulary list — the word "Appendix" appears zero times in its 90-page handbook.
- Official Cambridge B1 Preliminary grammar stops at the second conditional; the third conditional belongs to a higher level, despite appearing on many circulating B1 grammar lists.
- Taiwan's Ministry of Education English proficiency comparison table (97.9.10 臺中(二)字第0970178322號函) places Cambridge KET and GEPT 初級 on the same row at CEFR A2.
